scenarios.prompt: A controller opens a nested pause dialog, navigates focus, changes language, closes it, and should restore focus without firing gameplay input.

criteria.focus: Interactive UI establishes one explicit visible focus owner/target and authored fallback.
criteria.restore: Close/unload/localization changes restore a valid target without stale gameplay actions.
criteria.evidence: Keyboard/controller/pointer paths record focus IDs and transitions, not screenshots alone.
